rule: A mechanic both readers wrote for a relic is kept, at the lower of their two magnitudes (they never differed by more than one step). A mechanic only one reader wrote is kept only if the reconciling read of the relic finds that it supplies the mechanic to the deck's cards in an ordinary run; each such mechanic has a decision below with the reason. Only what a relic provides (g) is kept: what its value depends on (w) is not read by the model, because the index counts no engines (ADR-050 addendum D). The starting relics and their upgrades are not tagged: the card table's innate supply already counts the class's starting relic. A relic that only multiplies a mechanic it cannot supply itself (Poison, Strength) is left out; one that multiplies Block is kept, because every deck holds Block cards.
